full_judgment: 18. PW 12 Md Jahangir Hossain stated that on 16.9.88 he was sleeping in the shop of Haji Gafur Chand adjacent to the bank. Lokman dragged him by catching his hair. There was no shutter in the shop. Lokman Miah told him to go carefully if there was any outsider or not but he could not find any outsider but Lokman pushed him from behind and thereafter fired at him by his gun which struck him at heel. Thereafter Lokman entered into the bank and rang the alarm bell and fired blank shots. Many people hearing the sound of gun shot arrived at the place of occurrence and he narrated the story to those persons who were present. Thereafter local people and police arrested him and kept him under custody at the varandah. It is stated by the witness that the occurrence took place at the first floor of the building and about 70/80 shops are there at the ground floor. He stated that he and Nur Alam were staying at the first floor. He stated that he was serving at Nawab Abdul Malek Jute Mill as a guard. He stated that the motive for killing Humayun and injuring him was to show a vague or false incident as to commission of dacoity. He stated that he was in the hospital for 2 days.
